requires_runtime.notes: No runtime. The skill emits or merges settings.json blocks; it installs no code.

upstream.notes: Source-of-truth is the upstream repo. Mall vendors a snapshot; when upstream tags a new release, Mall automation flags the mismatch.

scope_note.reason: setup-enterprise-stack writes enabledPlugins to .github/copilot/settings.json by default, not user scope. Azure, Fabric, Power BI, and M365 are project-specific tools; loading them at user scope makes every unrelated workspace pay for skills it will never invoke. The skill supports a --user opt-in.
